show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/QkXUp8
show.description: A thousand-year-old prince, Keshav Rajakans, awakens in the body of a modern 6-year-old child. Uncertain whether this is fate or a conspiracy, he navigates the dark politics of the Rajakans family, using his sharp mind to disrupt the status quo. The question remains: can a child alter his entire destiny?
